title: Remove #[allow(dead_code)] suppressions: delete dead items, drop stale annotations
description:
## Audit findings (2026-05-21)

9 suppressions found. 4 to eliminate, 5 to keep with comments.

### Actions

**DELETE these items entirely (3):**

1. `crates/apiserver/src/types.rs` — `Object::namespace()` — zero callers anywhere; namespace read directly from JSON at all call sites
2. `crates/apiserver/src/types.rs` — `Object::resource_version_u64()` — zero callers; resource version manipulated as string or via `set_resource_version(u64)`
3. `crates/apiserver/src/tls.rs` — `test_temp_dir()` inside `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` — uncalled test helper

**DELETE the annotation only (1), code is fine:**

4. `crates/apiserver/src/auth.rs:40` — `UserInfo::uid` — field IS read in production at `handlers/authorization.rs:279`; the `#[allow(dead_code)]` is stale from before TokenReview was wired up

**KEEP+COMMENT (5, no code change needed):**

- `mcp-server/src/main.rs:14` — `U7sTools::tool_router` — consumed by `#[tool_router]` proc macro via `ServerHandler`; rustc can't see macro-generated usage
- `types.rs:166` — `ResourceMeta::namespaced` — only read in `#[cfg(test)]` assertion blocks
- `auth.rs:56` — `SaClaims::iss` — deserialized for schema completeness; issuer validated by jsonwebtoken before the field is read
- `rbac.rs:23` — `Subject::namespace` — deserialized for schema compliance; RBAC name-only matching for now; comment already present
- `rbac.rs:31` — `RoleRef::api_group` — same pattern; comment already present

## Quality gates

- `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` must pass after deletions
- `cargo test --workspace` must pass (no test regressions from deleting dead items)
- `cargo fmt --check`

## Rule 14

Delete tests are inherent (removing dead code can't break existing callers — if it does, the callers would surface as compile errors). The stale annotation removal (UserInfo::uid) is verified by clippy passing clean.

title: Node proto decoder: preserve NodeSpec and NodeStatus fields
description: decode_node_proto in proto.rs (lines 244-271) extracts only ObjectMeta from the protobuf. NodeSpec (field 2) and NodeStatus (field 3) are silently discarded. This causes the node to appear malformed to controllers and may trigger retry loops in kubelet. Fix: extend decode_node_proto to capture spec and status fields, or convert the incoming protobuf to JSON and merge with existing stored object. Medium complexity.

title: quota: ResourceQuota status.used never updated, kubectl describe quota shows stale usage
description:
## Problem

crates/apiserver/src/quota.rs: check_resource_quota() live-counts objects correctly for enforcement but never writes back status.used to the ResourceQuota object. kubectl describe quota always shows 0 used (or last human-written value), breaking observability.

## Implementation shape — IMPORTANT

Do NOT update status.used inline inside check_resource_quota() or from a post-write hook in the handler pipeline. Inline writes from the admission path risk reentrancy (a quota status PUT could itself trigger admission) and produce incorrect results if the CREATE succeeds admission but fails storage.

Instead, implement a background reconciler task in crates/apiserver/src/main.rs following the same pattern as reconcile_kubernetes_endpointslice():
- Spawn a tokio task that periodically (every 30s is fine) iterates all ResourceQuota objects in the store.
- For each quota, live-count the matching resources (reuse the counting logic already in check_resource_quota or extract it into a pure function).
- If status.used differs from the live count, call store.put() with the stored revision (optimistic concurrency — same pattern as the EndpointSlice reconciler after PR #551).
- Wire a shutdown signal via tokio::sync::watch following the same pattern used for the EndpointSlice reconciler.

This is purely observability — enforcement correctness is unchanged. The reconciler runs asynchronously and tolerate a ~30s lag in displayed counts.

## Files
crates/apiserver/src/quota.rs — extract counting logic into a reusable pure function
crates/apiserver/src/main.rs — spawn reconciler task (follow EndpointSlice reconciler pattern)

## Done-when
After creating a pod against a quota, within 30s status.used.pods reflects the live count in the stored ResourceQuota object. Regression test: create a pod, call the reconciler directly (not via the background loop), verify status.used.pods incremented. Shutdown signal wired and tested.
close_reason: count_quota_usage() pure function extracted; background reconciler in main.rs updates status.used every 30s with optimistic concurrency and shutdown signal. 3 regression tests. PR #558.
